problem.title: Count Islands With Total Value Divisible By K

approaches.title: Flood-fill each island and sum its values
approaches.summary: Scan the grid for unvisited nonzero cells, then use an iterative depth-first flood fill to mark each island visited and compute its total. Count the island when its sum is divisible by k.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Implement iterative flood fill with a newly allocated stack per island, sum each island’s values, and count sums divisible by k.
Reuse one stack across flood fills, clearing it before processing each island to avoid allocating a new stack each time.
